# utils.place_basis { #jaxidem.utils.place_basis }

```python
utils.place_basis(
    bounds=jnp.array([[0, 1], [0, 1]]),
    nres=2,
    aperture=1.25,
    min_knot_num=3,
    basis_fun=bisquare,
)
```

Distributes knots (centroids) and scales for basis functions over a
number of resolutions,similar to auto_basis from the R package FRK.
This function must be run outside of a jit loop, since it involves
varying the length of arrays.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type                                                                 | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | Default                       |
|--------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------|
| bounds       | Float\[Array, \'ndim 2\'\]                                           | The bounds for each dimension for the space we want to cover with basis functions                                                                                                                                            | `jnp.array([[0, 1], [0, 1]])` |
| nres         | int                                                                  | The number of resolutions at which to place basis functions                                                                                                                                                                  | `2`                           |
| aperture     | float                                                                | Scaling factor for the scale parameter (scale parameter will be w=aperture * d, where d is the minimum distance between any two of the knots)                                                                                | `1.25`                        |
| min_knot_num | int                                                                  | The number of basis functions to place in each dimension at the coursest resolution                                                                                                                                          | `3`                           |
| basis_fun    | Callable\[\[Float\[Array, ndim\], Float\[Array, nparams\]\], float\] | The basis functions being used. The basis function's second argument must be an array with three doubles; the first coordinate for the centre, the second coordinate for the centre, and the scale/aperture of the function. | `bisquare`                    |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                      | Description   |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------|
|        | A Basis object (NamedTuple) with the vector and matrix functions, and the |               |
|        | parameters associated to the basis functions.                             |               |
